desc: Tanfoglio proudly presents the all-new Stock Optic Ready, a high-performance pistol designed for shooters who demand precision and versatility. Engineered with advanced features, this model delivers exceptional handling and adaptability for a wide range of applications. The Stock Optic Ready is equipped with a flat double-action trigger for smooth, consistent pulls, while its full-length dust cover, free of a rail, enhances balance and ergonomics. Custom G10 grips provide superior control and comfort, ensuring the pistol feels as exceptional as it performs.
